Planned maintenance Sat night: we're upgrading our production Postgres database to a newer major version, since the current one is nearing end of security support. Expect a window of up to 10 hours for the cutover, covering restore and validation. Some service interruption is possible during that time; we'll post updates here as it progresses.

Cutover-day runbook outline (for on-call):
1. Freeze deploys and schema changes from T-2h; post freeze notice in #platform-ops.
2. Confirm the new large-tier instance is healthy and the restore from the latest snapshot has finished.
3. Put the app in read-only mode, stop writers, and wait for replication lag to reach zero.
4. Repoint the connection string to the new instance and bounce the app pools.
5. Run the validation checks (row counts, key tables, a smoke test of write paths) and sign off in the channel.
6. If validation fails, roll back to the old instance before the window closes.

text.name: Postgres production cutover checklist
